scope: SEC completed filing index and submission review, November 18–19, and original quarterly statements.

disposition.EXPD: November 18 exhibit is an investor presentation. Existing November 3 release remains the latest quarterly results.
disposition.ROST: Explicit fiscal 2026 third-quarter results and October 31 statement period. Headline discusses fourth-quarter outlook separately.
disposition.FE: February 17 annual release and same-day Q4 strategic highlights checked. Published results table is full-year and no directly reported Q4 GAAP diluted EPS was identified.

AES.finding: The acquisition announcement confirmed cancellation of the Q4 call and prospective publication of the 10-K. The 10-K EPS schedule uses the fiscal year. Separate quarterly publication dates and Q4 GAAP diluted EPS remain pending.

TECH.finding: FY2027 Q1 issuer result entry lists the original and amended 10-Q without a separate release. Amendment explicitly corrects signatures only.

ECHO.finding: Q3 10-Q verifies financial metrics and filing date. The other November 3 filing reports voting results under Item 5.07. A separate Q3 financial results publication remains pending.

TRGP.finding: The 10-K share-count reconciliation is annual. The original Q4 supplement gives Q4 net income and reconciles it to adjusted EBITDA, while Q4 GAAP diluted EPS remains unverified.

TXT.finding: Page 14 of the Fact Book repeats the Q4 $1.33 on the basis of continuing operations. The annual EPS of $5.12 in the same row matches continuing operations in the 10-K, which provides $5.11 for total annual diluted EPS. The original release also explicitly scopes the $1.33 to continuing operations.

directQuarterRevenue.indexing: Zero-based HTML table and row indices before expanding colspan.

SKYD.finding: Current comparative preserves the distinction between predecessor, successor and combined pro forma basis.

FE.finding: February 17 Item 2.02 expressly covers fiscal year 2025. The separately furnished Q4 slides contain operating statistics for Q4 and an annual earnings presentation. The annual FactBook was also reviewed. Standalone consolidated Q4 results publication and diluted EPS remain pending.

mainReconciliation.basis: Retain the source-audited draft roster and quarterly values. The five more recent main quarters were all checked against original statements and incorporated in this batch.

automaticIngestionReplay.scope: Replayed original SEC documents for November 18–20 through check_issuer and compared the six quarterly fields against the manually reconciled records above.

historicalCompanyFactsReview.scope: Queries for the pending revenue and diluted EPS fields used reported start/end dates, known GAAP revenue tags and diluted or combined basic/diluted earnings-per-share tags. Only durations of 75–107 days inclusive were considered.

rejectedCandidate.finding: Both quarter-duration EPS facts come from the EPS calculation for Corteva common stockholders in the Vylor filing. They do not describe Vylor seed-business EPS.

fiscalYearEndReview.scope: Compared all 503 active issuer mappings with the retained verified Q4 periods. Reviewed SEC submissions for the 125 tickers with at least one different closing month. Filing-based transition disclosures take precedence for AMCR, FDX and FERG.

trackedFilings.finding: Credit facility and receivables purchase agreement.
Chief financial officer transition and related announcement.
Long-term guidance update and a regulatory order.

intradayFilingReview.scope: Intraday snapshot. Latest acceptance is reported separately for each form. Results do not establish coverage after the acceptance cutoff.

upcomingCalendarFollowup.scope: Issuer investor-relations announcements for the next 30 days of tracked estimates. Record explicit planned results publication separately from the conference call.

sourceReviewNotes.DELL: Dated call and statement that results will be issued before the call. The company notice does not name a calendar date for the release itself.
sourceReviewNotes.ORCL: The issuer FAQ expressly gives the date of its next release. It does not state timing or a separate call date.

visibleFilingProvenanceReview.scope: Compared the 2,515 retained official quarter records with website history. Matched the existing official filing links against SEC accession, period end, form, filing date and company. Co-registrants and legal succession were checked against the original filings. Only the financial-filing provenance fields and review date were updated.

directFourthQuarterRevenueReview.scope: Retained fiscal Q4 revenue records previously annotated as annual less first nine months. Company-quarter matches use unambiguous original quarter dates or fiscal-quarter headers and published units. A targeted KeyCorp review also covers its other four retained quarters.
